resources.string: Network Advisor
No suggestion right now
Network Advisor speaks up when the current network has no confirmed internet and another network does.
Try %1$s instead
%2$s has no confirmed internet right now. %1$s does.
Based on Android\'s own connectivity check
Open network settings
Opens Android settings. AERIVA does not switch networks for you.
Network settings could not be opened on this device.
One network available
Android reports one network, so there is nothing to compare.
No network to compare
Network Advisor needs at least two networks. None is available right now.
A device policy blocks every available network, so there is nothing to suggest.
Not enough information to compare
More than one network passed Android\'s check. AERIVA does not measure speed or delay in this version, so it cannot say which is better.
Android has not said which network is in use, so Network Advisor cannot compare.
A VPN is active on the current network, so a comparison of networks may not reflect how the VPN performs.
A VPN is active. This comparison may not reflect how the VPN performs.
Some of these networks are metered and some are not.
Suggestions paused
The list of networks may be out of date, so Network Advisor is not suggesting anything.
